metadata.boundary: Executes a private immutable copy of a caller-built Prime Agent bundle associated with an ordinary clean-Git check of the pinned source revision and exact audited lockfile. The adapter does not install dependencies or build the bundle, and no authoritative released bundle digest proves the source-to-runtime relationship.
metadata.accounting: Assistant message_end usage and cost are lower bounds because the public event stream does not prove complete child-tree attribution.
metadata.build_identity: Optional caller-supplied Node, npm, and bundle SHA-256 pins make those local bytes stable for a run; they do not turn them into an authoritative upstream build.
metadata.workspace_owner: The caller-built bundle owns a disposable single-trial worktree; do not add a local environment block.
